urls.rationale: Article 1 (Short Title, Definitions) — defines 'lobbyist' and related terms used by both the Lobbyist Registration Act and the rest of the ethics regime.
Article 2 (Restricted Activities) — restrictions on lobbying-adjacent activities by public officials, cross-referenced from 25 ILCS 170.
Article 3 (Code of Conduct) — conduct rules invoked when officials interact with registered lobbyists.
Article 3A (Governmental Appointees) — disclosure obligations for appointees, part of the ethics-regime disclosure framework.
Article 4a (Disclosure of Economic Interests) — statements of economic interest filed by officials and registered lobbyists; central disclosure mechanism.

notes: Skipped Article 3B (Boards and Commissions) and Article 8 (Severability) — neither carries lobbying-disclosure substance.
